# RH_Lean

> Lean 4 (v4.34.1) research repository on the Riemann Hypothesis. RH is NOT proved here. The repository formalizes reductions (for example the canonical VF form of von Koch's 1901 criterion), imports the unconditional OpenAI 7/8 zero-free theorem, and records ten open proof routes. One phenomenon — the square-root-scale fluctuation of pi - Li_2 and of the Mertens function M, governed by the zeta zeros — appears under many coordinate systems and names. Before treating any object as new, look it up in the coordinate atlas.

Status and integrity rules: a compiled conditional theorem does not prove its premises; explicit interfaces such as `ClassicalVonKochRHCriterion` are hypotheses, not proofs; paper and numerical results are not Lean certificates; open-PR state must be read from GitHub.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): status, the von Koch (1901) milestone, current research summary
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): conduct, permissions, reading order for research agents
- [CURRENT_PROOF_CONTRACT.md](CURRENT_PROOF_CONTRACT.md): exact current target and conventions
- [docs/PROOF_DEPENDENCY_DAG.md](docs/PROOF_DEPENDENCY_DAG.md): every proposition, typed implication and RH route with its unpaid inputs (data: [docs/proof-obligations.json](docs/proof-obligations.json))
- [docs/FORMALIZATION_MILESTONES.md](docs/FORMALIZATION_MILESTONES.md): what is finished in Lean, and what each result does not prove

## Find the same object under a different name

- [docs/COORDINATE_ATLAS.md](docs/COORDINATE_ATLAS.md): 41 coordinate systems, typed crosswalks with evidence status, notation collisions (D, C, E, K, Q, ...) and normalization traps (data: [docs/coordinate-atlas.json](docs/coordinate-atlas.json))
- [docs/search/INDEX.md](docs/search/INDEX.md): one small page per coordinate and per route, with every proved Lean rewrite of the coordinate and the files that use it under any alias
- [docs/search/README.md](docs/search/README.md): the committed JSONL shards (file catalog; rewrite families `<def>_eq_...`) for code search without running Python
- [docs/REPOSITORY_SEARCH.md](docs/REPOSITORY_SEARCH.md): full-text and module-DAG search commands

## Commands (Python 3, standard library)

- `python3 scripts/coordinate_atlas.py lookup D_R`: every meaning of a symbol, alias or Lean name
- `python3 scripts/coordinate_atlas.py path COORD-VF-CAN-DEFECT ANCHOR-MERTENS --lean-only`: strongest-evidence crosswalk chain
- `python3 scripts/proofq.py repo-search "q2 daughter" --expand`: full-text search across every alias of the named coordinate
- `python3 scripts/proof_obligation_dag.py --check`: validate the proof DAG
